critical_gaps.title: Worker output never applied to codebase
critical_gaps.description: execute_subtask_batch_parallel dispatches AI requests to the fabric, stores responses in result dicts, but NEVER applies output to files. The system orchestrates perfectly but produces no tangible changes.
critical_gaps.impact: HIGH — Orchestrator is a metadata manager, not a code modifier

critical_gaps.title: Timeout cascade on every fabric call
critical_gaps.description: litellm (15s) → opencode (instant 403) → gemini (0.8s timeout) → groq (instant 403) → alibabacloud (0.8s timeout) → digitalocean (instant 403) → simulation. Each fabric call takes ~17s before falling through.
critical_gaps.impact: HIGH — Every worker subtask costs ~17s even with simulation. 8 fabric calls × 17s = ~136s wasted in timeouts alone.

critical_gaps.title: No circuit breaker for consistently failing providers
critical_gaps.description: If litellm consistently times out (e.g., Gemini overloaded), the fabric tries it first on every call and waits 15s each time before moving on. No mechanism to temporarily disable a failing provider.

critical_gaps.title: Learning dedup only works forward
critical_gaps.description: Existing duplicates (LEARN-0001 through 0005 all same title/category) persist permanently. No cleanup mechanism for pre-existing duplicates.

critical_gaps.title: Cold-path registries grow unboundedly
critical_gaps.description: knowledge.jsonl, agents.jsonl, chain.jsonl are append-only with no compaction, TTL, or pruning. After 3 runs: 17 KB knowledge entries.
critical_gaps.impact: LOW — will accumulate over time but not performance-critical

medium_improvements.title: Add circuit breaker to fabric dispatch
medium_improvements.description: Track consecutive failures per provider. After N consecutive failures (e.g., 3), skip that provider for a cooldown period instead of trying it every time.

medium_improvements.title: Proactive provider health checking
medium_improvements.description: Run a lightweight health-check ping against each provider at startup. Mark unhealthy providers with cooldown instead of discovering them through timeouts.

medium_improvements.title: Spawn chain overlap with cold-path chain
medium_improvements.description: The spawn_chain_registry.json (15 entries from hot learning) and chain.jsonl (3 entries from cold promotion) track overlapping promotions in different formats. Should be unified or cross-referenced.
medium_improvements.notes: Currently cross-referencing works (cold-path entries reference spawn chain IDs), but the reverse doesn't.
